learning_outcomes.text: Explain how wind turbines convert kinetic energy to electricity and the role of the power curve
Describe the main turbine components and onshore vs offshore configurations
Assess a wind resource from wind-speed distributions and the cube law
Interpret capacity factor, cut-in and cut-out speeds and the Betz limit
Outline wind-farm layout, wake effects and basic siting constraints
Identify grid-integration and environmental considerations for wind projects

integrative_case: A community energy group is evaluating a four-turbine onshore site: judge the wind resource from a year of mast data, estimate the capacity factor, lay out the turbines to limit wake losses, and summarise grid and environmental constraints for the planning submission.
